sign: Seat of the Gilt House. Every roof is gold. Every wall has ears.
South: the White Stair. East: Cloudshadow Meadow. West: the Sunfall Terraces.

lines: House Physician Velka: The Gilt House pays for your rest. The Gilt House will remember that.
Gilt Quartermaster Rennick: Fine goods at family prices. Not your family. Ours.
trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew focus_brew

lines: Maid Lisette: I polish the roofs at dawn. The gold comes off on my hands. So does everything else in this house.
Footman Tobiah: Lord Aurek has five children and one chair. Dinner here is a sport.
Nanny Griselda: I raised all five Gilt children. I taught them manners. Somebody else taught them knives.
The summer feast begins under golden roofs. Aurek raises a glass to the Wayfarer who did his dirty work.
Steward Corvel: The family thanks you. The family is also, regrettably, poisoned. Please stay for dessert.
Aurek's own children poisoned the feast to take the house. You were the alibi. Trust no one, least of all a family that says you are one of them.
